items.title: QuickBooks Auto Payroll preview: $2,772.58 to be withdrawn
items.summary: Intuit's Auto Payroll preview landed in albert@'s inbox Aug 10 confirming the upcoming pay run will withdraw $2,772.58 from BMO - Titan Flooring. Routine automatic payroll debit, informational only, no action needed unless the amount looks wrong.

items.title: Interac e-transfer: $2,000 from Damian Martin auto-deposited
items.summary: info@ forwarded a Damian Martin Interac e-transfer notice to albert@ Aug 9 confirming $2,000 was automatically deposited. Money incoming, no action needed.

needs_attention: Catch-up widening: last successful Outlook ingest was 2026-08-09T01:01:58-04:00 (~31h before this run), older than the 24h window_hours, so this run pulled 36h on Inbox and 60h on Sent Items (36h + unanswered_threshold_hours buffer) per max_catchup_days=7 to close the gap. All 4 mailboxes and both folders succeeded this time.

Quiet window: no customer or supplier emails landed across any mailbox in this ~36h window, so no unanswered-customer flags today. Only 2 routine admin items (a QuickBooks Auto Payroll preview and an incoming Interac deposit) plus 5 noise items (WordPress plugin notice, 2 Google Business Profile notifications, a Meta Marketing API onboarding email, a newsletter).
